title: lib/util/ml_dsat.h: Update comments to use block comment style
body: Seems like a small change, but fixes builds against NSS headers when projects require strict ANSI C (C89/C90) mode, which refuses support of newer C slash-slash comments.

title: lib/softtoken/{sdb.c,sftkdbti.h}: Align sftkdb_known_attributes_size type
body:
sftkdb_known_attributes_size is defined with conflicting types. In /lib/softtoken/sdb.c it is defined as a 'const size_t'; whereas in lib/softtoken/sftkdbti.h it is defined as an 'unsigned int'. The correct type for sftkdb_known_attributes_size is size_t since its value is derived from the size of the sftkdb_known_attributes array.

Fixes: 1983399

title: Corrected ASN.1 syntax of DH key export template
body:
The ASN1Template structure array for DH private keys was an array, however missing the leading SEC_ASN1_SEQUENCE entry.
Without this change no DH private keys are importable because only the privateValue is decoded, the base and prime are ignored.

title: lib/freebl/genload.c: drop call to PR_SetError
body:
Drop call to `PR_SetError` in `genload.c` as already done in `lowhash_vector.c` to avoid adding a dependency on a function defined in nspr and raising the following build failure when `FREEBL_NO_DEPEND` is set to 1 (default on Linux):

```
/home/buildroot/autobuild/instance-3/output-1/host/opt/ext-toolchain/bin/../lib/gcc/microblazeel-buildroot-linux-musl/11.2.0/../../../../microblazeel-buildroot-linux-musl/bin/ld: Linux2.6_microblazeel_microblazeel-linux-gcc.br_real_glibc_PTH_DBG.OBJ/Linux_SINGLE_SHLIB/lowhash_vector.o: in function `loader_GetOriginalPathname':
(.text.loader_GetOriginalPathname+0x1c4): undefined reference to `PR_SetError'
```

title: Fix for the gcc compiler version 7 to support setenv with nss build
Subject: [PATCH] Fix SHA_HTONL bug for arm 32be.
body:
Rpm use nss as digest crypto library and which will cause an error on
arm 32be platform as follows:

error: test-manual-1.2.3-20181012.noarch.rpm: Header SHA1 digest: BAD
(Expected
f1deb7dc4a10742d88ccd1e967dbc62ae45095a5
!=4ad9d7dad6d70d6086eefec62612ad5d77f2fe81)  => this value is wrong
error: test-manual-1.2.3-20181012.noarch.rpm: not an rpm package (or
package manifest)

The error is caused by SHA_HTONL in nss, for there is no need to reverse
the host value for arm 32be as it is originally big endian, so fix it.

Signed-off-by: Zheng Ruoqin <zhengrq.fnst@cn.fujitsu.com>

title: WIP: EKT
body:
This branch implements the TLS parts of the [current draft of Encrypted Key Transport](https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-ietf-perc-srtp-ekt-diet-07).  There are two main things:

* The client and server negotiate an EKT cipher via the `supported_ekt_ciphers` extension
* The server sends an EKT key and associated data in an `EKTKey` handshake message after its `Finished` message

There are currently tests that these basic functions work.  Known issues:

* Does not work with TLS 1.3, due to the different handling of post-handshake messages
* Does not provide reliability for the `EKTKey` message (I think)
